results.title: Seetha Payanam
results.overview: Seetha’s road trip with Abhishek, a stranger unfolds through unexpected detours and quirky encounters with unforgettable people. After a life-altering accident, she retraces her journey, and discovers the true power of destiny

results.title: The Art of Seducing God
results.overview: Haunted by a dream of his late mother pleading for salvation from the afterlife's torment, a troubled and estranged son embarks on a spiritual journey to uncover the true meaning of wisdom, hoping to redeem both his mother's soul and his own fractured faith.

results.title: Closing Shift
results.overview: KC, a movie theater employee on the brink of quitting, works the closing shift with her manager, Reggie. When the night takes a sinister turn due to their customers, KC and Reggie must figure out how they will make it out alive and decide whether they still want to work at the movie theater.

results.title: The Green Monster
results.overview: A Christmas gathering turns horrific when a family’s inherited home is discovered to be haunted by a legend known as the Green Monster.

results.title: Ruby, Ruby
results.overview: When they awaken a deadly curse, two young women, Ollie and Hannah, find themselves trapped in a haunted cemetery with a malicious predator, thrusting them into a nightmarish battle for survival against evils, both supernatural and human.

results.title: Regulars
results.overview: On Halloween night in a Brooklyn dive bar, where a group of misfit regulars — led by a Dominican-American bar owner — get trapped and uncover a murder, spiraling into a chaotic, culture-soaked whodunnit where everyone’s got secrets… and everyone’s a suspect.

results.title: Royally Screwed
results.overview: A rebellious prince and a witty waitress collide in Manhattan, sparking a royal romance that tests tradition, tabloids, and the crown.

results.title: Brian
results.overview: An acerbic high school student prone to panic attacks runs for class president to get closer to his teacher.

results.title: The Scout
results.overview: Sofia works as a location scout for a TV pilot filming in New York City. It’s her job to find the homes, businesses, and exteriors where the show will be filmed. Driving around the city's different neighborhoods, she enters the private spaces of strangers to photograph their cozy apartments and eclectic shops, stepping into the fabric of their lives while trying to satisfy the demands of her erratic employers. Over a day filled with these encounters, Sofia witnesses moments of curiosity, vulnerability, and quiet tension until her work takes a sudden, personal turn.

results.title: Evel
results.overview: Trapped inside an autonomous electric vehicle on an isolated highway, a young woman must survive as a malevolent force systematically erases her digital footprint before delivering her to a ruthless billionaire predator.

results.title: The Cactus
results.overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

results.title: Oldburgh
results.overview: The story of one ned's desperate attempts to preserve the filth of his rotten town, Oldburgh.

results.title: Sugar & Vice: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
results.original_title: Sugar & Vice: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
results.overview: Hannah finds a body at the grand re-opening of the Lake Eden Inn. When a storm traps everyone inside, Hannah must find the culprit before the road clears and the killer escapes.

results.title: How to be a Billionaire with Xavier Niel
results.overview: Xavier Niel hosts a comedy show about his success.

results.title: Novak
results.overview: An ageing Serbian neuroscientist lives a reclusive life in Athens, having been branded as a paranoid schizophrenic for his radical research on the effects of electromagnetic radiation on humans. But when, decades later, he is rediscovered by a group of young dreamers who are trying to change the world through his ideas, he decides to quit his medication and join them in their scientific commune, risking his sanity in pursuit of a higher goal.

results.title: Holding
results.overview: While waiting on hold for insurance approval, a sickly man starts to hear unsettling sounds through the line that unravel a sinister secret about his claim.

results.title: Rahu Ketu
results.overview: In the magical world of writer Churu Lal Sharma, his unlucky creations Rahu and Ketu spring to life, causing hilarious chaos instead of fighting corruption. When the mischievous Meenu Taxi steals Churu's mystical notebook, the bumbling duo are dragged into absurd adventures that land them in the middle of a drug mafia.

results.title: Bad Parenting
results.overview: Two young brothers are left alone in a car while their dad paddleboards out at sea. When a mischievous local boy climbs into the backseat, an ordinary beach day takes a dangerous turn.
